entries.rationale: Adds the `token_` qualifier because the bare word `prices` is ambiguous inside a namespace that also carries prediction-market prices (solana.predict.market's buy/sell price fields). Verb `get`: the tool answers a lookup for named ids (mints or resolvable queries), not a screen.
Mechanical; `search` is already the canonical free-text verb and the description states the tool is for tokens you can already name.

Semantic rename. The toolId says `trending` but the tool serves seven categories (recent, toptrending, toptraded, toporganicscore, verified, lst, stocks) plus liquidity/organic-score/verification filters, and its own first sentence is 'Discover Solana tokens without already knowing a name'. `discover` is the canonical filtered-screening verb and stops the name under-describing the surface.
mechanical snake_case conversion; matches the plan's kyberswap__swap_quote exemplar
mechanical snake_case conversion

Verb added and chosen against its sibling: this tool filters by category/status/provider/tags and sorts and pages, which is screening, so `discover`. Its own description routes keyword lookups to solana.predict.search, so the two verbs must differ.
Resource made explicit: the tool searches EVENTS, not markets, and returns eventIds the caller then feeds to the event/market getters. `search` is the canonical free-text verb.
Verb added; singular resource preserved because the tool takes exactly one eventId.
Verb added; detail-by-id lookup on one marketId.
Verb added; one market's book, addressed by marketId.
camelCase split to snake_case plus an explicit `get`; the tool takes no parameters and reads one global flag.
Verb added. `list` rather than `discover`: the scope is one wallet's own open positions with a bounded limit/offset window, not a market screen.
Verb added; singular kept, addressed by positionPubkey. The singular/plural pair now differs by verb as well as by number, which the bare toolIds did not.

Resource named. `history` alone collides with two other histories in the same family (solana.predict.pnlHistory, solana.predict.orderStatus's fill-event history); this one is the wallet's PAST closed/settled trades, so `trade_history`.
Verb added; bounded owner-scoped page, no server-side filters exist upstream.
Verb added; one order by pubkey.

camelCase split plus `get`. Kept as its own name rather than folded into order_get because the two differ in a load-bearing way: order_get errors once the order account closes post-fill, this one survives closure.
Verb added. `list` and not `discover`: the feed is global with no upstream owner/market scope and only a client-side limit/offset window, so there is nothing to filter on.
Verb added; single lifetime snapshot for one wallet, session-scoped.
camelCase split plus `get`; one wallet's PnL time series over a named interval.
Singular/plural normalization: one call returns ONE leaderboard (period + metric are both required), so the plural resource was wrong. The plurality lives in the verb.
`Info` dropped as a noise suffix (the verb now carries it) and camelCase split. Reads the protocol vault's pubkey and balance; takes no parameters.
camelCase split plus `list`. Not `discover`, because the only inputs are a wallet address and a provider, and the ranking is the provider's personalization, not a filter the caller applies.
mechanical snake_case conversion; mutation kept atomic
mechanical snake_case conversion; mutation kept atomic
mechanical snake_case conversion; mutation kept atomic
mechanical snake_case conversion of the camelCase segment

Family qualifier added. `solana.lend.*` holds two distinct Jupiter programs, EARN and BORROW, and four of the seven descriptions spend a sentence correcting the confusion the shared prefix creates. Putting `earn` in the name makes the split visible before the description is read.
Same EARN qualifier; without it this name and solana.lend.borrowPositions read as siblings when they are different programs with different position shapes.
EARN qualifier added; its own description has to say 'not collateral for borrowing' precisely because the toolId does not.
EARN qualifier added; distinguishes it from the collateral withdrawal inside solana.lend.borrowOperate.
camelCase split plus `list`; the vault-config read that borrowOperate depends on for decimals and risk thresholds.
camelCase split plus `list`.

camelCase split only. `operate` is kept as the action because the tool really is one multi-leg lifecycle call (deposit/withdraw collateral and/or borrow/repay debt in one transaction); splitting it into four verbs would misrepresent the single approval and the single ledger entry.
